notes.title: [1.1.0] Introducing difficulty settings!
notes.content:
Hello there!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added difficulty settings: Kindergarten, Casual, Hard, Insane
[*] Kindergarten: Limited cameras to 3/4/5 (Bowling/House/Office)
[*] Kindergarten: Set game duration to 10 minutes
[*] Kindergarten: Intruder, Entity and any scary or disturbing anomalies are prevented from spawning
[*] Casual: Limited cameras to 4/4/5 (B/H/O)
[*] Casual: Set game duration to 15 minutes
[*] Hard: Limited cameras to 4/5/6 (B/H/O)
[*] Hard: Set game duration to 20 minutes
[*] Insane: All cameras available
[*] Insane: Set game duration to 20 minutes
[*] Reworked spawning logic to prevent semi-softlocks
[*] Small changes to several items' positions
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*] Elevator doors on the Office can sometimes be dark
[/list]

notes.title: First post-launch update
notes.content:
Hi!

I've noticed a bug regarding gathering one statistic counting towards the achievements.
This update should set up the current value to the same of the "all anomalies" achievement and from there it should persist and be updating on its own correctly.

If anyone still notices issues with the numbers, please let me know.

Additionally, in one or two places, I decided to remove some "noise" objects. Less distraction should ease the initial play a bit :)

Happy spotting!
